specific_buyer.notes: Initial buyer is explicitly 2-25 employee HVAC, plumbing, roofing and electrical owner-operators, GMs and marketing leads.

urgent_problem.notes: Source-backed evidence supports customer-acquisition difficulty, high home-service lead costs, and growing multi-surface discovery/reputation complexity. This is market-problem evidence, not willingness-to-pay proof.

compelling_offer.notes: Fixed product promise and seven-surface offer are defined. Customer conversion remains unvalidated.

pricing_model.notes: Core $299/location/month, Growth $599/location/month, Agency from $1,499/month are defined target prices. Live billing is intentionally disabled.

proof.notes: A runtime-clean staging product exists, but no real customer outcome, permissioned case study, or attached automated E2E run exists yet.

customer_source.notes: A source-qualified Massachusetts beachhead and pilot selection method are documented; no outreach has been sent.

acquisition_channel.notes: Free scanner, precision account-based outreach, evidence media, proprietary benchmarks and agency distribution are specified with gating metrics.

conversion_mechanism.notes: Staging exposes Free Exposure Scan -> report -> Request activation. Activation is deliberately non-charging.

payment_infrastructure.notes: Stripe architecture is designed but no live Product, Price, Checkout or subscription path has been activated. Live billing requires explicit approval.

fulfillment_system.notes: Core fulfillment surfaces are deployed and runtime-clean, but full E2E acceptance remains unverified because the deployment provider attached no E2E run.

onboarding.notes: Synthetic sandbox bootstrapping exists; production customer onboarding and integration credential intake are not verified.

customer_support.notes: Support surface is explicitly a private-beta placeholder; production support channel and service posture are not committed.

retention_mechanism.notes: Recurring value loop is designed around monitoring, recovery, reputation and attribution, but retention has no real-customer evidence.

expansion_path.notes: Location expansion, Growth tier and Agency/multi-location distribution are explicitly sequenced after direct-customer proof.

unit_economics.notes: Gross-margin, CAC-payback and churn targets exist but have no actual customer cohort evidence.

measurement.notes: Product ledger separates DETECTED, PIPELINE, BOOKED and REALIZED while GTM defines weekly funnel and economics metrics. Demo data is excluded from real totals.

legal_operational_basics.notes: No fake-review/sentiment-gating rules and action authority are defined, but production privacy, terms, tax, refund/cancellation and outbound-compliance posture require review.

automation.notes: Governed state machines are deployed, but real external adapters intentionally fail closed and therefore production automation is not activated.

accountability.notes: Authority boundaries, fail-closed external effects, state transition guards and audit receipts are part of the project and deployed staging posture.

continuous_demand_validation.notes: No cleared customer payment or executed payable commitment exists. Policy requires this criterion before commercial PASS.

defined_buyer.notes: Initial buyer and vertical boundaries are explicit.

fixed_offer.notes: Seven-surface offer and promise are fixed for v0.

price.notes: Target plan prices are fixed for validation; live collection remains disabled.

proof_asset.notes: A working staging demonstration exists, but no real customer before/after result or permissioned proof asset exists yet.

qualified_lead_source.notes: Pilot prospect sourcing method and initial cohort research exist.

sales_path.notes: Verified scan -> report -> activation request -> diagnostic/onboarding path is defined.

payment_path.notes: Live Stripe path intentionally not activated or verified.

fulfillment_path.notes: Runtime-clean staging exists, but automated E2E fulfillment evidence is still missing.

direct_outreach_and_follow_up.notes: Outreach system is planned but the first external batch has not been approved or sent.
